fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Caitlyn''' sets a visible trap at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}} and arms after 1 second, lasting for a duration. The trap grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for 1 second after being placed.
fields.description2: '''Caitlyn''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Yordle Snap Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount. Deploying traps beyond the maximum destroys the oldest one.
fields.description3: The next enemy champion that springs the trap is {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|true sight|revealed}} for 3 seconds, as well as takes additional damage from the ''{{ai|Headshot|Caitlyn}}'' granted by this ability. Trapped targets become immune to further ''Yordle Snap Traps'' for 3 seconds, preventing them from springing subsequent traps for the duration.
fields.notes: * Multiple armed traps on the same location will spring all at once if an enemy steps on one of them.
